name: Streamline Selection by Parcellation
summary: An automated and reproducible pipeline to extract streamlines from a tractogram based on a labeled parcellation image.
description: Splits the parcellation into one binary mask per label (nibabel) and runs MRtrix3 tckedit -include for each mask in parallel, writing one tractogram per parcel; with ends_only only streamlines that terminate in the parcel are kept. Use it to get region-wise bundles from a whole-brain tractogram. The tractogram and parcellation must be in the same space.

inputs.description: Labeled volumetric parcellation; each non-zero label becomes one ROI.

outputs.description: One .tck tractogram per parcellation label with the streamlines that intersect (or end in) that parcel.

parameters.description: filtering only the streamlines ending in the parcels

citations.text: Tournier JD, Smith R, Raffelt D, et al. MRtrix3: A fast, flexible and open software framework for medical image processing and visualisation. NeuroImage 202, 116137 (2019).
